title: Spectrum 27 Flip-Through
content: This year's edition ofSpectrumpresents a juried selection of contemporary fantasy art, including dragons, warriors, monsters, trolls, angels, and dinosaurs.ThisYouTube videotakes you through all 304 pages in less than a minute.Spectrum includes fantasy and science-fiction artwork in several categories, including book, comics, film, horror, illustration, sculpture, conceptual art, fine art and video game genres.Chris Dunn,illustration fromWind in the Willows9x12 inches,watercolor and gouache.While most artists create their art with digital media, there are plenty of examples painted in watercolor, gouache, and oil. The book contains 350 works by over 220 diverse artists, including Tommy Arnold, Wylie Beckert, Rovina Cai, Dan dos Santos, Jesper Ejsing, Cory Godbey, Iain McCaig, Daniel Zrom, Tran Nguyen, Greg Ruth, Cynthia Sheppard, Yuko Shimizu, Claudya Schmidt, Terryl Whitlatch, and me.----The book releases November 10, but you can pre-order at this link:Spectrum 27: The Best in Contemporary Fantastic Art----If you like fantasy art, you'll also enjoy the new bookEnchanted: A History of Fantasy Illustration
